title: She used to work the fields in rural Gujarat. Now she installs solar panels - and the PM noticed. October 31, 2026.
excerpt: From a man who negotiated 500 kingdoms into one country, to a minister born in Bihar now running Britain's AI policy, to a trillion-dollar export target that's turning into arithmetic, to a farm worker turned solar technician praised on national radio - October 31's four stories are about reshaping what's possible from where you started.
bodyHtml:
Every story today is about redrawing a boundary - a map stitched together through negotiation rather than conquest, a career path that crossed three countries before reaching a cabinet table, an export target moving from aspiration to arithmetic, and a field worker's hands learning a new trade entirely.

October 31, 1875: a boy was born in Gujarat who would later talk over 500 separate kingdoms into joining one country

Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, independent India's first Deputy Prime Minister, is credited with integrating more than 500 princely states into the Indian Union. India has observed October 31 as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas - National Unity Day - since 2014, marking his 151st birth anniversary in 2026.

He was born in Bihar, moved to Delhi at 12, then Wales as a teenager. In 2026, he became Britain's first AI minister

Kanishka Narayan, born in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, was appointed the UK's first-ever dedicated Minister for Artificial Intelligence on July 20, 2026 - a path that took him from Delhi to Cardiff to Oxford to Whitehall.

India's commerce minister says a $1 trillion export target is within reach

Piyush Goyal said India remains on course for $1 trillion in combined exports in FY27, 16% above FY26's record - with April-August exports already up over 15% year-on-year, backing the target with real trade data rather than just optimism.

She used to work the fields in rural Gujarat. Now she installs solar panels - and the PM noticed

Payal Munjpara, from Surendranagar district, trained as a solar technician and now installs rooftop solar systems under the PM Surya Ghar scheme. PM Modi praised her on Mann Ki Baat, and she was invited to the Red Fort Independence Day ceremony in August 2026.

Four stories, one pattern: a country stitched together by negotiation, a career that crossed three nations to reach a cabinet table, a trillion-dollar target turning into simple arithmetic, and a pair of hands that learned to build something new entirely.
